title: Phoenix Console
subtitle: Local-first operations for backup, readiness, and archives.
actionsUnavailable: Manual actions unavailable for this request.
manualActionsDetail.loopbackOnly: Manual browser actions are available from this same-machine loopback session. Phoenix permits explicit local backup, health check, watch, and managed hook operations here, but still does not expose restore or config editing in the browser.
manualActionsDetail.loopbackNetwork: Manual browser actions are available because this request came from loopback on the Phoenix host. Even on a wider bind, Phoenix does not treat this as a remote admin panel.
manualActionsDetail.remoteDisabled: Manual browser actions are disabled for this request. Phoenix only permits them from the same machine over loopback, so this browser surface is not intended for remote administration.
manualActionsDetail.unknown: Phoenix could not confirm that this request came from loopback, so manual browser actions stay unavailable until the console is opened locally on the Phoenix host.
manualActions.unavailable: Manual actions are not available for this request.
